name: Golem Kingdom — approved tribal dungeon
alignment: Native source pixels, no scaling, rotation, filtering or recoloring
reconstruction: Built-in image_gen used only to reconstruct terrain hidden beneath extracted foreground. Every visible source pixel is preserved exactly; hidden surfaces of movable objects are not synthesized.

limitations: Semantic terrain masks and object outlines are editable raster selections; visible-source cutouts are not complete 3D objects.
Racks may retain a few background pixels in narrow irregular gaps; adjoining buildings can form connected clusters.
Collision shapes, navigation, engine depth sorting and lava animation are not authored in this art-only package.
